replies.author: ALM
replies.body:
Devs have every permission, this includes the ability to punish. Dev rarely punish and only do in extreme cases where logs can be used as evidence. Dev are not trained nor asked to answer reports/deal with hackers. Usually, the only punishment a dev will give is for something chat related. 

Also, I believe the thinking was to have MapDev and Dev similar since they are both developers of some part of the network.
